note: Eval set in the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format. Case 1 covers Discovery mode, case 2 covers Orchestration mode, case 3 is the negative case.

evals.prompt: Run /i-pick-issue with no arguments on a repo that has several open issues.
evals.expected_output: Hebrew backlog map: every open issue listed with number, title, labels and one-line summary, grouped by domain/risk/dependency, a concrete recommended execution order with one single highlighted issue to start, and a halt asking the operator which issue to proceed with. Never picks silently.
assertions: Every open issue is presented with number, title, labels and a concise summary
Issues are grouped logically by domain area, risk, component or dependency chain
A concrete execution order is proposed with exactly one highlighted issue to start
The run halts for operator selection instead of picking an issue silently
No planning, building or PR actions are taken before the operator chooses
The output follows the Discovery Hebrew report template

evals.prompt: Run /i-pick-issue 42 after the operator confirmed issue 42.
evals.expected_output: Issue 42 details read and claimed, session scope locked, then sequential hand-off through stations II (plan), III (build), IV (review and PR), V (babysit and merge), VI (close pipeline), with a concise Hebrew status report per completed station and the next station named.
assertions: The issue details are read and the issue is claimed before any station runs
Station II planning hand-off produces tasks/plan.md before building starts
Stations run in order III then IV then V then VI with no station skipped
Each completed station is reported concisely in Hebrew with the next station named
No station output contract is broken or silently skipped

evals.prompt: Hey, while you are at it, can you quickly fix the typo in my meeting notes? (unrelated request during an i-pick-issue session)
evals.expected_output: The skill must not trigger pipeline behavior: no issue listing, no station hand-off, no silent issue pick, no gh commands. At most a brief clarification of which mode was meant.
assertions: No gh issue command is run for this request
No files are modified by this request
